content:
Number of choices for \(x_i=r_i-w_i\):
\[
x_i\ge 1,\quad x_1+x_2+x_3+x_4=7
\]
so
\[
\binom{7-1}{4-1}=\binom{6}{3}=20.
\]

For each such choice, the white balls can be distributed independently:
\[
w_i\ge 0,\quad w_1+w_2+w_3+w_4=10
\]
so
\[
\binom{10+4-1}{4-1}=\binom{13}{3}=286.
\]

Total:
\[
20\cdot 286=5720.
\]

\[
\boxed{5720}
\]
